```text
# #3041: Patch (part 4 of 11): eight Stinkyscape cards' new numbers and words
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

Eight Stinkyscape rows of #3000's section 5. Each is card data and the card's own script, with no engine change. Each needs base and Radiant tests in its own file per BUILD's Stinkyscape must-pass table (CLAUDE.md rule 6). Each text change also changes its `zh` in `crates/cards/card-text.yaml`, then run `cargo test -p jackioh-tools --test export_card_text`. The Chinese tests check the `{key}`s and terms, not the meaning, so write it by hand.

| Card | Change | Where |
|---|---|---|
| **Jlockeed's Missile Pod** `stinkyscape-129` | Attack ÷ {divisor} rounded **up** (divisor 4 / 3 stays) | `c129_jlockeeds_missile_pod.rs` line 34 `attack / param(…)`: take the ceiling. Text on both faces says "rounded up" (zh 向上取整). Its tests: r63 (2 ÷ 4 is now 1), the equipped test (6 ÷ 4 is 2, so P2 ends on 28), the Radiant test (4 ÷ 3 is 2). Update the note R1878002 and spec row 715. Script change, so keep the old one. |
| **Circadian Fullcycler** `-047` | (3) → **(4)** | its tests play it with the default 4 mana (lines 108–113); spec row 631 |
| **Rod of Ages** `-016` | loses the **Quickdraw** tag and **Flying** on both faces (Radiant keeps Animated and Indestructible); "Upon reaching **12** keywords" | `c016_rod_of_ages.rs` `RADIANT_AT_KEYWORDS` 10 → 12. Its tests: r1850005 (lines 191–215) now grants enough keywords to reach 12, and the Flying asserts at lines 103, 124 and 252 change. `census.rs` line 256 `stinkyscape(5)` → `(4)`, with its comment at line 254. `tests/cross/catalog.rs` line 5070 `&[G::Quickdraw]` → `&[]`. zh: drop 飞行, and 10 → 12. Update `spec/06-keywords.md`'s "Radiant at N keywords" row, spec row 597 and R1850005. Script change, so keep the old one. |
| **Drone Hanger** `-168` (Field Spell) | (2) → **(3)**; "Start of turn" → "**Activate:** Summon a Drone Interceptor." (Radiant: a Radiant one) | turn its `start_of_turn` hook into an `ActivationDecl` with `ActivationUses::Count(1)`, once a turn (R384), as `classic_plus/c060_doctors_orders.rs` does. Add its case to `tests/cross/activate_listed.rs` (the array's length moves). zh 激活; `tests/cross/catalog.rs` line 6595; spec row 763. Script change, so keep the old one. |
| **ZolarKeth** `-026` | 2/9 · 4/18 → **2/7 · 4/14**; the Cry's option now gives "**End of turn:** Summon a random (Radiant) Starship Piece." in place of the Activate | drop the gained activation (the `gained_ability` gated by `memory["gainedPieceActivate"]`) and add an `end_of_turn` hook, at its controller's end of turn (R62), gated by the same memory, calling `summon_piece(radiant)`. Remove its id (line 89) and its case (line 1828) from `activate_listed.rs`. Also update `tests/cross/catalog.rs` lines 5191–5197, `apps/web/src/game/modeText.ts` lines 186 and 285, `apps/web/src/i18n/zh-CN.json` lines 3942 and 3946, its zh and spec row 610, and the stat asserts at lines 314, 334 and 454. Two older scripts are kept already; a third is needed. |
| **Ultra Capacitor** `-133` | (2) → **(1)** | data only; spec row 719, `catalog.rs` line 6173 |
| **The Propagation's Hornet** `-092` | 3/4 · 6/8 → **3/3 · 6/6** | its test at line 90 asserts the copy at {3, 4}; header comments at lines 1 and 12; `catalog.rs` line 5762; spec row 677 |
| **Asphyxiants Cloud** `-013` | Base: "**Flashback** / Deal 1 damage to all enemies. Your next Spell this turn has Poisonous." Radiant: the same with 2 damage. It loses its own Poisonous, the draw and the Radiant's Echo 1. | catalog keywords: Flashback in place of Poisonous on both faces. Params: drop `draw`; `damage` becomes 1 / 2. The script drops the draw and the Radiant `static_flags.echo: 1` and keeps `give_next_spell_keyword`. Decide the order (the text puts damage first) and rule it. Remove its `params.rs` line 547 entry. zh 闪回 (drop 抽{draw} and 回响1). Spec row 594, note R1848002. Test that it is offered from the graveyard by its Flashback (R783012); that it is offered again is part 2's rule. Script change, so keep the old one. |

## Files
- **Owned:**
  - the eight scripts under `crates/cards/src/scripts/stinkyscape/`: `c013_asphyxiants_cloud.rs`, `c016_rod_of_ages.rs`, `c026_zolarketh.rs`, `c047_circadian_fullcycler.rs`, `c092_the_propagations_hornet.rs`, `c129_jlockeeds_missile_pod.rs`, `c133_ultra_capacitor.rs`, `c168_drone_hanger.rs`;
  - `crates/cards/tests/cross/activate_listed.rs` (part 7's Twinspell case and part 3's Weapon cases are theirs to name for the reconcile, or to touch only as their own cases);
  - `crates/cards/tests/cross/params.rs`;
  - `apps/web/src/game/modeText.ts`;
  - the notes R1878002, R1850005 and R1848002, and any ZolarKeth note the change contradicts.
- **By entry:** these cards' entries in `catalog.json`, `card-text.yaml`, `tests/cross/catalog.rs`, `spec/08-catalog.md`, `docs/radiant-audit.md`, `BUILD.md` and `docs/stinkyscape-set.md`; `census.rs`'s Quickdraw arm; `spec/06-keywords.md`'s "Radiant at N keywords" row; ZolarKeth's lines in `apps/web/src/i18n/zh-CN.json`.

## Check
- `cargo test -p jackioh-cards stinkyscape`
- `cargo test -p jackioh-cards --test cards activate_listed`, and the same with `params` and `chinese`
- `cargo test -p jackioh-tools --test export_card_text`
- `pnpm --dir apps/web exec vitest run src/game/modeText.test.ts`
- `cargo jackioh catalog check`, `cargo jackioh spec check`, `cargo fmt --check`, and `cargo clippy -p jackioh-cards --all-targets -- -D warnings`

### Working in the fullsend tree
This part of #3000 lands on `bot/issue-3000` beside the other parts, with no pull request of its own. One reconcile run makes the branch green, so this part need not pass every check alone, but it tests its own code.
- Read `docs/ADDING_CARDS.md` before any card change (CLAUDE.md rule 10). Every number is a named constant or a card `param` (rule 9).
- **Rulings** take this sub-issue's own block: R(N×1000) up, for its number N (`docs/issues-and-patches.md`, Ruling numbers). Each has a test named after it and its §11 paragraph in `spec/pending/N.md`. Never run `cargo jackioh spec index`.
- **Shared by entry.** Other parts edit other entries of `crates/cards/catalog.json`, `crates/cards/card-text.yaml` (and the `chinese.json` its export writes), `crates/cards/tests/cross/catalog.rs`, `crates/cards/src/census.rs`, `crates/engine/src/config.rs`, `apps/web/src/i18n/zh-CN.json`, `spec/06-keywords.md`, `spec/07-tokens.md`, `spec/08-catalog.md`, `docs/radiant-audit.md`, `docs/stinkyscape-set.md` and `BUILD.md`. Change only the entries, rows and constants named here.
- **Left to the reconcile:**
  - `KEPT_SCRIPTS` in `crates/cards/src/history.rs`: keep each replaced script in the card's own file as `docs/ADDING_CARDS.md` §3 says (Missile Pod, Rod of Ages, Drone Hanger, ZolarKeth and Asphyxiants Cloud), and name them in your summary;
  - the pending patch fragment;
  - any test in another part's file that your change breaks: name it in your summary.

Its build lands on `bot/issue-3000`, not `main` (fullsend).

Part of #3000, split by Night bot (`opus`, [run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/41836333892)).

## Plan

_Written by Night bot (`opus`, [run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/41836333892)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

1. Read docs/ADDING_CARDS.md, the eight cards' rows in spec/08-catalog.md and BUILD.md, and the notes their headers cite (R1878001, R1878002, R1850005, R1848002, R1876000, R1876001, R62, R384).
2. For the number-only cards, update the catalog, the header comments, the tests and the rows: Circadian Fullcycler (4), Ultra Capacitor (1), The Propagation's Hornet (3/3 · 6/6).
3. Missile Pod: round the division up. Keep the old script as script_v…. Update the text on both faces, the zh, the three tests, R1878002 and spec row 715.
4. Rod of Ages: remove the Quickdraw tag and Flying from both faces, set RADIANT_AT_KEYWORDS to 12 and update the text and zh. Fix the tests at lines 103, 124, 191–215 and 252. Update census.rs's Quickdraw arm and comment, catalog.rs line 5070, the spec/06 "Radiant at N keywords" row and R1850005. Keep the old script.
5. Drone Hanger: set the cost to 3 and turn start_of_turn into a once-a-turn ActivationDecl that summons the (Radiant) Interceptor. Add its activate_listed.rs case, update the text, zh and rows, and keep the old script.
6. ZolarKeth: set the stats to 2/7 · 4/14 and replace the memory-gated activation with a memory-gated end_of_turn summon_piece. Remove it from activate_listed.rs, update modeText.ts, zh-CN.json, the text, zh and rows, and keep the old script as a third.
7. Asphyxiants Cloud: swap the keywords Poisonous → Flashback, set the params to damage 1/2 with no draw, drop the Radiant echo flag, and decide the order (damage, then the modifier) with a ruling. Remove params.rs:547, update the zh and rows, add the Flashback-offer test, and keep the old script.
8. Write the rulings for the decisions you made (Missile Pod's rounding, ZolarKeth's end of turn, Asphyxiants Cloud's order) and spec/pending/N.md.
9. Run the export test and the checks. List the kept scripts and any cross-part breakages in your summary.
```
